steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 8
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: My neighbor waters my plants when I travel.
I have a few errands to run this afternoon.
I finally have a day off tomorrow.
